title: Composition preserves normalization of derived internal Hom comparisons
statement: Let R,S,Z be commutative ring sheaves on small sites, with unbounded derived categories in one localization universe [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let F:R-modules to S-modules, G:S-modules to Z-modules and V:R-modules to Z-modules be additive exact functors, and let c:F composed with G isomorphic to V. Assume F preserves K-injective complexes. Let a,b be specified ordinary Hom comparisons for F,G and e,s specified derived Hom comparisons, normalized against a,b by the representative equation [lem-ringed-hom-restriction-comparison-descent]. Then the transported composite of e,s along mapDerivedCategoryCompIso inverse followed by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(c) is normalized against the transported composite of a,b along mapHomologicalComplexCompIso(c). This asserts no existence of comparisons and no equality with an independently chosen direct comparison.

source.place: Tags 08J7, 0A95 and 08JB; the construction of internal Hom and its restriction comparison

proof.text: Fix L and K-injective I. Apply G to the normalization equation for e at L,I. Since F(I) is K-injective, use the normalization equation for s at F(L),F(I). Naturality of s moves the F localization-factorization isomorphisms through s, and composing the two equations gives normalization for the composite before transporting c.

proof.text: Use naturality of the augmentation on the complex isomorphism induced by c. The localization-factorization equations for mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso identify the representative transport with the specified derived transport. Cancel the intermediate invertible factors. This is exactly the normalization equation asserted.

theorem composite_normalized
    {C D E : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D] [SmallCategory E]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {N : GrothendieckTopology E}
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (Z : Sheaf N CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules S)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules Z)]
    (F : Modules R ⥤ Modules S) (G : Modules S ⥤ Modules Z) (V : Modules R ⥤ Modules Z)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [V.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (c : F ⋙ G ≅ V)
    (hF : ∀ I : Complex R, I.IsKInjective →
      CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))
    (a : ordinary R ⋙ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).op.prod
        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙ ordinary S)
    (b : ordinary S ⋙ G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).op.prod
        (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙ ordinary Z)
    (e : derivedInternalHom.{u, w} J R ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (F.mapDerivedCategory.op.prod F.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ derivedInternalHom.{u, w} K S)
    (s : derivedInternalHom.{u, w} K S ⋙ G.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (G.mapDerivedCategory.op.prod G.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ derivedInternalHom.{u, w} N Z)
    (he : Normalized R S F a e) (hs : Normalized S Z G b s) :
    Normalized R Z V (composite (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso c (.up ℤ)) a b)
      (composite ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso F G).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso c) e s)
